_comment: Editorial study-grouping overrides bundled with the app. Each override replaces the default 3-verse rule for the verses it covers and must carry a rationale. Published CMS groupings for a surah replace these. Status: approved by the app's editorial rule set; no scholarly claim is made.

groupings.rationale: Keeps the opening praise of Allah (1:1–4) together; the default rule would end the first study after 1:3.
Keeps the worship-and-request passage (1:5–7) together as one study.
